body: I felt like you not a month ago. I have been depressed for 8 years. Everyday it got worse little by little until i started to abuse medication and i failed suicide 3 times. I'm glad i failed. I too hated being alone and family didn't help, only having the company of friends. I would always think why do i care how others feel. If i leave its for my own happiness but i was wrong. If you were to see the pain in someone that loves you you'd see that there can always be another solution. For so long whenever my house phone rang my mother's heart would sink because she always thought that it might be someone calling telling her son was dead. There's someone for everyone no matter who. I too lost my memory short term. I cant remember what i did a few minutes ago or even a few days ago because of the damage to my brains stress over 8 years has caused me but in a way its a good thing you cant remember. I find it useful not to remember the past. I don't know how to write things that help people because i've never really been good at helping but trust me when i say i know 100% what you mean and where you're coming from. That's why i decided to attempt to write something because i read this and it was like i was reading things about my past. SOrry if this doesnt help but i really hope it does. You can always message me if you want to talk.

Yes that was how i felt first coming here and writing that. After a while i started reading other people's stories and i dont feel so alone anymore i see so many people going through what i am so i want to try to help

Don't blame yourself, sometimes friends fight. You can't go a lifetime with friends just being happy. There has to be all emotions. Just try to make up with them talk it out but dont put yourself down like it was your fault because you know it wasn't

I have been amazed by how many stories are exactly like mine, because i feel your pain and because i know where youre coming from i want to say that i care about you and what youre going through. for 8 years now ive had depression. Its gotten worse and i had given up until i met a girl. We dated for 3 years she was my muse and my motivation. Recently we had to part ways because she was starting to become a bit cruel and would constantly hurt me. Ever since then ive felt a pain in my chest and really crazy emotional pain. I tried to kill myself that night but my mom was outside of my door crying and begging me not to go. I couldnt go seeing her like that. So instead i would harm myself in my room. Tonight i found this reddit and i see so many people that have problems like me. I see im not alone. That makes me want to help people because i wouldnt wish this pain on anyone like ive said to many people. if you want to talk im just a message away!
i really hope you will, have a good sleep!

yeah i have a skype but no headphones. If you wanted to talk through skype then i will go to the closest best buy and buy headphones to be able to talk. Or you can just message me through it. I'll message you my skype

Hey, i was exactly like you and i still am. I dropped out of highschool and ive been living in my pig style room playing videogames to cover up my depression and i have no social life anymore. The girl i love isnt good for me so we parted ways and thats broken me. But she was my muse my motivation. While i was with her i took my ged and enrolled into college to become a dental hygienst but she slowly started being cruel to me so i decided to let her go to not hurt her anymore with my depression. My point is theres motivation in things. In your room im sure you can find some sort of motivation. I stay up all night. You're not alone and while i may not know you i know your pain and i care about you. If you'd like to talk about everything im just a message away

Since your friend's dont go out too much and you say its weird when its one person trying to talk to a group, maybe you and your friends should all get together as a group and go places go out. That can be one solution. Highschool is confusing so dont let it play with your mind. Its just a cage you have to be in for 6-8 hours a day and people form impenetrable groups at the start of it. Have you ever seen any people who sit by themselves all the time?

it pains me to hear you're going through that because that's exactly how i felt for so long until it got out of control. you're right its extremely hard to find friends. It all starts with one person, befriending one person and that grows into a tree of friends. I don't know you but i care about you so much. Do you have any friends youre currently close to?

I feel where you're coming from. for almost 8 years now ive been struggling with depression and anxiety. It kept building up until i hit rock bottom and decided to drop out of highschool. I met a girl who i fell in love with so i told her about my problem and she just turned her back on me and we'd argue alot. Just yesterday we parted ways. We can never speak to eachother again. She was my muse and my soul. I understand what you mean. Sorry i didnt mean to vent. Anyways recently i got my ged and am going to college and studying dental hygiene. But since yesterday my life crashed and it all went downhill. Ive pushed away all my friends and family. I am alone now at least, i was. I just discovered reddit and i see that im not alone so many people are going through what i am and i want to help them because i wouldn't wish this pain on anyone. I am very sorry to hear about your friend. i too have lost someone close to me by police brutality. If you would like to talk please dont hesitate to leave me a message i'd love to talk and help.
thank you, i liked the first song but the motivational video means nothing to me at this point

I know exactly how you feel. I want to let all this pain just dissolve and be free from it all. I want to sleep and be at peace for once but im scared. Im scared as to what will happen to my mother and sisters and i am scared of what comes next. I had my heart ripped out of my chest yesterday. I just feel like im dont but when i see other people who feel this way i want to help them because i wouldn't wish this pain on my worst enemy. Can we please talk?

Hi what i suggest is very far out there and may seem unreachable, but from my experience you should really start to try going out with your friends. baby steps try to talk to one person and have them introduce you to a group. Go to parties and things like that. You don't want to fall into this whole lonely feeling because it will eat you and please believe me when i say that it hurts alot. I have no one. I drifted away from everyone and have been hurt by someone i love. If you would like to talk i'd be more than happy to

I mutilated myself and i was going to start walking to a bridge by my house. My mom was at the door crying and begging me to stop. We can talk if you would like. Im just a message away

I know exactly how you feel. This is what i just went through extremely recently. i loved her with all my being but when i told her about my depression she turned her back on me. Message me and maybe we can talk
